d: To deliver high-quality, engaging teaching of Computer Science across Key Stages 4 and 5, primarily following the Pearson Edexcel GCSE (9-1) Computer Science and Pearson Edexcel A Level Computer Science specifications, ensuring students achieve strong outcomes and develop a genuine passion for the subject.
q: Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) or equivalent; Degree in Computer Science, Computing, or closely related discipline
Experience teaching Computer Science at KS4; strong subject knowledge of programming (Python essential)

Experience teaching KS5 (A Level) Computer Science; specific experience delivering the Pearson Edexcel GCSE/A Level Computer Science specifications; experience supervising NEA/coursework to completion
Strong understanding of computational thinking, algorithms, data structures, computer systems, networks, and cyber security as covered at GCSE/A Level
Familiarity with Edexcel's specific NEA requirements, on-screen exam format, and SAM (sample assessment material) resources; knowledge of additional languages (e.g. SQL, HTML/CSS, Java, C#)
Ability to plan sequenced, engaging lessons; strong classroom/behaviour management; effective use of assessment for learning
Experience using tools such as PRIMM, Parson's Problems, or other pedagogically-researched CS teaching approaches
Ability to use data to track and improve student progress
Track record of strong Edexcel GCSE/A Level outcomes
r: Plan and deliver well-structured lessons for GCSE and A Level Computer Science in line with the Pearson Edexcel specifications
Deliver programming instruction (Python is the primary language used in Edexcel specs) to a high standard, including practical/on-screen assessment preparation
Prepare students effectively for the Edexcel non-exam assessment (NEA) at A Level and the on-screen programming project at GCSE
Set appropriately challenging work, assess progress regularly, and provide effective feedback in line with school marking policy
Use assessment data (including Edexcel past papers and mark schemes) to identify gaps and inform intervention
Differentiate teaching to meet the needs of all learners, including SEND and EAL students
Contribute to curriculum planning, schemes of work, and resource development aligned to Pearson Edexcel specification updates
Stay current with Edexcel specification changes, examiner reports, and grade boundary analysis
Support moderation and standardisation of NEA/coursework components
Contribute to option evening presentations and student recruitment into KS4/KS5 Computer Science
•Act as a form tutor / contribute to pastoral duties as required
•Promote high standards of behaviour, attendance, and engagement
•Contribute to extra-curricular provision (e.g. coding club, competitions such as Bebras or NCCE challenges)
•Engage fully with CPD, appraisal, and professional development processes

d: MADI International is looking for a commercially driven Sales Educator – Skincare to join our team in Oman. This role is ideal for a qualified Skin Therapist with hands-on experience in facial treatments and a strong background in sales.

The successful candidate will combine technical skincare expertise with sales capabilities to deliver professional demonstrations, develop salon and spa accounts, introduce skincare brands and products, and drive sales growth across the assigned territory.
Conduct hands-on facial demonstrations and professional skincare treatments to showcase product benefits, protocols, and results.
Drive sales through technical product knowledge, demo-led selling, and value-based negotiations.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with salons, spas, skincare professionals, and existing clients.
Identify new business opportunities and expand the company's skincare brand portfolio across assigned accounts.
Convert product demonstrations and client consultations into confirmed orders and repeat business.
Achieve assigned sales, brand-specific, and collection targets.
Promote new launches, monthly promotions, focus products, and approved commercial offers.
Conduct regular client visits, follow up on opportunities, and maintain effective territory coverage.
Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and customer needs, sharing relevant insights with the management team.
Collaborate with Sales, Education, Marketing, and Brand teams to execute brand strategies and achieve business objectives.
q: Proven experience as a Skin Therapist, with hands-on expertise in facials, professional skincare treatments, and skin analysis.
Previous sales experience in Oman, preferably within the skincare, professional beauty, salon, spa, or aesthetics industry.
Strong knowledge of professional skincare products, ingredients, treatment protocols, and product application techniques.
Experience conducting facial demonstrations and converting them into sales.
Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets, develop accounts, and generate new business.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Commercially minded, proactive, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Professional certification or a diploma in skincare, aesthetics, or beauty therapy is preferred.
Fluency in English is required; Arabic is an advantage.
Willingness to travel within Oman for client visits, demonstrations, and training sessions.
Opportunities to work with leading professional beauty and skincare brands.
Career growth opportunities within MADI International.
